blaze.name: Emberheart
blaze.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Fire moves deal ×1.5 damage.

torrent.name: Tidecaller
torrent.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Water moves deal ×1.5 damage.

overgrow.name: Verdant Fury
overgrow.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Grass moves deal ×1.5 damage.

swarm.name: Hivemind
swarm.desc: Below ⅓ HP, Bug moves deal ×1.5 damage.

intimidate.name: Dreadroar
intimidate.desc: On entry, cows the foe — its Attack drops until it switches.

technician.name: Finesse
technician.desc: Weaker moves (60 power or less) deal ×1.5 damage.

adaptability.name: Zealot
adaptability.desc: Same-type attack bonus is ×2 instead of ×1.5.

serene-grace.name: Twin Fate
serene-grace.desc: Burn and paralysis chances are doubled.

mold-breaker.name: Breaker
mold-breaker.desc: Moves ignore the foe's defensive abilities.

no-guard.name: Deadeye
no-guard.desc: Every move by or against it lands — no misses, no dodges.

sturdy.name: Bedrock
sturdy.desc: Survives any single hit from full HP with 1 HP left.

levitate.name: Skyborne
levitate.desc: Hovers: immune to Ground moves and tile effects.

wonder-guard.name: Spectral Ward
wonder-guard.desc: Only super-effective moves can deal damage.

water-absorb.name: Thirst
water-absorb.desc: Immune to Water moves and heals ¼ HP when hit by one.

volt-absorb.name: Conduct
volt-absorb.desc: Immune to Electric moves and heals ¼ HP when hit by one.

flash-fire.name: Kindle
flash-fire.desc: Immune to Fire; being hit by one powers up its Fire moves.

motor-drive.name: Overclock
motor-drive.desc: Immune to Electric; being hit by one raises its Speed.

dry-skin.name: Porous
dry-skin.desc: Absorbs Water, weak to Fire; heals in rain, hurts in sun.

clear-body.name: Composure
clear-body.desc: Its stats cannot be lowered by Intimidate.

static.name: Livewire
static.desc: 30% chance to paralyse attackers that make contact.

flame-body.name: Cinderskin
flame-body.desc: 30% chance to burn attackers that make contact.

effect-spore.name: Spore Cloud
effect-spore.desc: 30% chance to burn or paralyse attackers on contact.

rough-skin.name: Barbed Hide
rough-skin.desc: Attackers that make contact lose ⅛ of their HP.

aftermath.name: Last Spite
aftermath.desc: When KO'd by a contact move, the attacker loses ¼ HP.

speed-boost.name: Quickening
speed-boost.desc: Speed rises every few seconds while out.

natural-cure.name: Mend
natural-cure.desc: Burn and paralysis are cured when it switches out.

shed-skin.name: Molt
shed-skin.desc: May shrug off burn or paralysis over time.

magic-guard.name: Charmward
magic-guard.desc: Only takes damage from direct attacks — no chip.

synchronize.name: Reflection
synchronize.desc: Passes any burn or paralysis it receives back to the foe.

chlorophyll.name: Sunchaser
chlorophyll.desc: Much faster in harsh sunlight or on the grass Pitch.

swift-swim.name: Streamline
swift-swim.desc: Much faster in rain or on water tiles.

sand-veil.name: Dustveil
sand-veil.desc: +20% dodge in sandstorms or the Cavern; immune to sand chip.

snow-cloak.name: Frostveil
snow-cloak.desc: +20% dodge in hail or on snow; immune to hail chip.

ice-body.name: Permafrost
ice-body.desc: Heals in hail or on snow and ice; immune to hail chip.

rain-dish.name: Raincatch
rain-dish.desc: Heals in rain or on water tiles.

hydration.name: Rinse
hydration.desc: Cures burn and paralysis in rain or on water.

drizzle.name: Stormcall
drizzle.desc: Summons rain on entry: Water ×1.3, Fire ×0.7.

drought.name: Sunflare
drought.desc: Summons harsh sunlight on entry: Fire ×1.3, Water ×0.7.

pressure.name: Overbearing
pressure.desc: The foe's move cooldowns are 25% longer.

frisk.name: Insight
frisk.desc: On entry, reveals the rival's whole hidden team.

leaf-guard.name: Sunward
leaf-guard.desc: Cannot be burned or paralysed in sun or on the Pitch.
